children: Prediction market platform Kalshi is investigating betting activity on contracts tied to U.S. President Donald Trump’s press secretary pick, according to The Wall Street Journal. According to ChainCatcher, three bets of about $19, $74, and $80 appeared before reports were published that Katie Zacharia had been selected.
The report said the contract ultimately settled as "yes," but it remains unclear whether the related accounts were subject to withdrawal restrictions.

title: Kalshi Investigates Bets on Trump Press Secretary Pick
